name: @erclx/canon
description: Runs your agent's work and keeps its code good, on one setup for every repo.

scripts.format: oxfmt . && prettier --write --log-level warn 'web/**/*.astro' && shfmt --write --indent 2 scripts/ tooling/ claude/
scripts.check:format: oxfmt --check . && prettier --check --log-level warn 'web/**/*.astro' && shfmt --diff --indent 2 scripts/ tooling/ claude/
scripts.check:shell: find scripts tooling claude .claude/hooks -name '*.sh' -exec shellcheck --severity=warning {} + && find .husky -maxdepth 1 -type f -exec shellcheck --severity=warning --shell=sh {} +
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules && bun pm cache rm && bun install
scripts.web:tokens: bun src/cli.ts design css --no-components > web/src/styles/tokens.css.new && (echo '/* Generated by `canon design css --no-components`. Regenerate with `bun run web:tokens`. Do not hand-edit. */'; cat web/src/styles/tokens.css.new) > web/src/styles/tokens.css && rm web/src/styles/tokens.css.new
scripts.web:build: bun run web:tokens && bun run web:favicon && bun run web:previews && cd web && astro check && astro build
